user.title: Set up Cover Control
user.description: Set up the global Cover Control instance. Rooms are added separately afterwards.

data_description.name: Name of the global Cover Control instance.

controller_reconfigure.title: Configure Cover Control
controller_reconfigure.description: Create and edit profiles centrally. A profile contains the automation rules for time, brightness, sun, shading, ventilation, resident behavior, and manual behavior.

menu_option_descriptions.global_sources: Configure shared Home Assistant entities such as workday, outdoor temperature, brightness, calendar, weather, and forecast sources.
menu_option_descriptions.profiles: Create and edit central profiles for time, brightness, sun, shading, ventilation, resident behavior, and manual behavior.
menu_option_descriptions.diagnostics: Inspect profile usage and the current Cover Control configuration.
menu_option_descriptions.recovery: Inspect or restore the last known valid Cover Control configuration.

global_sources.title: Global sources
global_sources.description: Choose Home Assistant entities shared by multiple rooms. Rooms can locally override individual sources when needed.

data_description.additional_condition_global: Optional Home Assistant condition applied globally before Cover Control runs an action.
data_description.brightness_sensor: Shared illuminance sensor used by rooms without a local brightness source.
data_description.calendar_entity: Shared calendar used by time profiles that evaluate calendar titles.
data_description.cold_protection_forecast_sensor: Shared weather or sensor source for cold protection forecast values.
data_description.shading_brightness_sensor: Shared illuminance sensor used for sun shading decisions.
data_description.shading_forecast_sensor: Shared weather entity used for forecast and weather-condition based shading.
data_description.shading_forecast_temp_sensor: Shared sensor that provides forecast temperature values for shading.
data_description.sun_elevation_dynamic_close_sensor: Shared sensor that provides a dynamic closing sun elevation.
data_description.sun_elevation_dynamic_open_sensor: Shared sensor that provides a dynamic opening sun elevation.
data_description.temperature_sensor_outdoor: Shared outdoor temperature sensor for shading and protection rules.
data_description.workday_sensor: Shared entity that indicates whether today is a workday.
data_description.workday_tomorrow_sensor: Shared entity that indicates whether tomorrow is a workday.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.description: Profiles define only Cover Control behavior. Hardware, window contacts, and room sensors are configured in the individual rooms. A profile can be used by several rooms or by only one room.

data_description.profile_action: Choose whether to create, edit, duplicate, or delete a profile.
data_description.profile_id: Select the profile for this action.

profile_sections.title: Profile sections

menu_option_descriptions.profile_time: Configure opening, closing, schedules, and calendar behavior.
menu_option_descriptions.profile_brightness: Configure brightness thresholds and light-dependent rules.
menu_option_descriptions.profile_sun: Configure sun elevation, thresholds, mode, offsets, and time conditions.
menu_option_descriptions.profile_shading: Configure shading conditions, thresholds, waits, temperature, brightness, and forecast rules.
menu_option_descriptions.profile_ventilation: Configure behavior for window contacts, delays, priorities, and ventilation rules.
menu_option_descriptions.profile_behavior: Configure manual behavior, movement protection, and additional behavior rules.
